topic_class: comedy skit (office lip-sync to film dialogue)

signature.one_line: Single moody office two-shot lip-sync under a persistent text colour condensed-serif headline.
unique_devices: Persistent 2-line headline in flat text colour #F7D312 condensed high-contrast serif, very tight leading, on the dark ceiling at 14-25 % H
Single uncut locked-off two-shot: the borrowed dramatic audio carries the whole joke
Moody low-key office grade with warm skin and a magenta/purple corner cast
Costume mismatch (sunglasses indoors) staged as a film scene
signature.why_it_works: Epic film dialogue over a mundane deadline meeting is an instant mismatch; the headline tells non-speakers what the scene is.

hook.type: In medias res (dialogue from the first frame)
hook.first_frame: locked-off medium two-shot at an office desk, both people in sunglasses, text colour serif headline over the dark ceiling

structure.what: dramatic question about a deadline under the headline
impossible promise vs doubt, exaggerated gestures
finger raised for the closing heroic line

background_text.how: condensed high-contrast serif ~80 px (Instrument Serif; line 2 slightly bigger), flat #F7D312, tracking -0.01 em, no stroke/shadow/box; band 14.2-25.2 % H, line 1 baseline 19.4 %, line 2 baseline 25.2 %, block centre x ~46 %; static

layout.how: subjects in the lower 70 %, empty dark ceiling/wall above for the headline

other_text_spec.type: persistent headline (no captions; the only text)

spec.script: latin (English headline; the audio is film-style dialogue in another language, not captioned)
spec.punctuation: one comma mid-line 1; no full stop

grouping.sync: not tied to speech; on for the whole video
grouping.break: a short set-up phrase on line 1 / the 2-word subject on line 2

layout.leading: very tight: line 1's descender touches line 2's ascenders (baseline pitch ~5.8 % of H)
layout.note: upper quarter, over the dark ceiling, above the standing subject's head; block centre x ~46 % (slightly left)

headline.font_class: condensed high-contrast serif (Didone-like, tall x-height, ball terminals; native in-app editor-style serif)

closest_match.note: Playfair Display is ~40 % wider than the original at the same height: use Instrument Serif, or Playfair at the height-matched size with transform scaleX(~0.6)
closest_match.web_font: Instrument Serif Regular (condensed high-contrast) — alt Oranienbaum

headline.k_note: a 2-word line with ascenders and no descenders measured 5.0 % H / 59.6 % W (k 0.73 -> ~132 px); the serif's ascenders rise above its caps
headline.size_note: line 2 words are set slightly bigger than line 1 (mixed sizes)

other_text_spec.text: no captions, logos, watermark or end card

headline.closest_local: Playfair Display 500 with scaleX ~0.6 (install Instrument Serif instead)

style.look_intent: moody low-key office: mid-contrast, natural-saturation, warm skin, deep shadows, magenta/purple corner cast

sound.music: voice only (pre-mixed film-dialogue / trend audio, no separate bed detected)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Oversized Editorial Headlines
catalog_styles.role: yellow condensed-serif headline framing the scene

catalog_styles.name: Dark Cinematic Motion Design
catalog_styles.role: moody low-key film look on an office set

use_when: a two-person office / team lip-sync to a dramatic audio clip
one static set-up, no editing budget, micro length
a headline can explain the joke for viewers who do not know the audio
avoid_when: the brand cannot use borrowed / licensed trend audio
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B28 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B28.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship — text and accent must stay >= 4.5:1 / >= 3:1 against what sits behind them on the footage):
- {{TEXT}}      default #F7D312 (headline yellow)
- {{ACCENT}}    default #F7D312 (same; single-colour style)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  default none
- {{SURFACE}}   default none (headline sits on a dark area of the footage)
- {{CARD_BG}}   default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} default Instrument Serif Regular (condensed high-contrast serif); local fallback Playfair Display 500 at scaleX ~0.6
- {{FONT_BODY}}    default same
- {{HANDLE}}    default @handle
- {{LOGO}}      default the brand's logo file (transparent PNG/SVG)
The headline needs a dark band of footage behind it: {{TEXT}} must stay >= 4.5:1 there; a bright brand colour works, a dark one does not.
Canvas 1080x1920, 24 fps.

CAPTIONS
1. No captions (the audio is a dialogue / trend track).

OTHER TEXT
2. One persistent 2-line headline for the whole clip, sentence case, no full stop (placeholder 'Headline here, lead words' / 'KEY WORD here'). {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at ~80 px with line 2 slightly bigger, {{TEXT}}, tracking -0.01 em, no stroke / shadow / box.
3. Placement: band 14.2-25.2 % H on the empty dark wall / ceiling above the heads; line 1 cap top 15.0 %, baseline 19.4 %; line 2 baseline 25.2 % (baseline pitch ~5.8 % H, descenders touching ascenders); centred block, centre x ~46 %.
4. Animation: none — on from frame 0 to the last frame.
5. No {{LOGO}}, watermark or end card.
6. Edit: one locked-off two-shot, no cuts; let the audio carry the joke.

GRADE
Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: moody low-key, warm skin, deep shadows, slight magenta/purple corner cast.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render the headline with 'Another' on line 1 and measure: python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.1,0.14,0.85,0.26 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60"
   Expected (±0.5 % H, ±2 % W): 'Another' ink 4.45 % H / 21.1 % W. Playfair cannot hit both (it is ~40 % too wide); with Instrument Serif solve the px for height, then check width.
b) Any word / font: python3 video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<font weight>" --word "<word>" --ink 4.45 --width 21.1 --tracking -0.01 gives the matching px for the calibration word; for other words pass --ink only. Re-check line 2 at ~5.0 % H for a 2-word line with ascenders. (fit_font.py needs a target: --ink and/or --width; it returns the px that reproduces that ink for YOUR word plus the width it will read at that px. Requires Pillow.)
c) Positions within ±1 % H: line 1 baseline 19.4 %, line 2 baseline 25.2 %.
